head: 9a392e23e2d8b6800cc91f2b1995d639f22ff3ca
review: Read-only material ownership/clip audit. No renderer, WebGL, Electron, repository mutation or GPU validation.

finding.summary: City-exclusive cached shop glass bypasses the city material ownership set and is unreachable from station root disposal.

chain.fact: Calls H.ctx.mat.glass directly for tint #e6eef0, opacity .14, streaks false.
ctx spreads station.ctx; mat remains the station material factory. Only source.M accesses pass through the city clone Proxy at line49.
Cache key is glass| + JSON.stringify(opts). New ShaderMaterial is inserted into cache at line188. Cache membership does not register an owner.
Disposal adds geometry and customDepthMaterial from root but does not collect ordinary object.material; only existing ownedMaterials are disposed at line60. Direct factory glass is not in that set.
Disposal collects materials by traversing station.root only, and does not iterate ctx.mat.cache. City root is separately mounted under the scene.

finding.scope: Affects explicit city/station disposal and accuracy of stats.materials. This audit does not assert a visible rendering regression or quantify leaked VRAM.

uniqueTintSource.text: const shopGlass = H.ctx.mat.glass({ tint: '#e6eef0', opacity: .14, streaks: false });

cacheEvidence.staticFinding: Scanned fixture src and all vendored Sakuragaoka JS glass call sites. The exact tint appears only at the new city call; other direct calls and the shopsA/shopsB wrappers use distinct literals/defaults. A full station CPU build was not performed.

clip.current: New key is created after station.clipMaterials has run. Factory defaults clippingPlanes=null, clipShadows=false, so current shop glass does not borrow the old station rectangle clip.
clip.potential: Factory cache hits retain mutations, including clippingPlanes. Directly borrowing a cache hit from station.root could retain station clipping; current exact key is not such a hit.

cpuProbe.scope: Actual material factory and Three classes; representative station-root with its existing house-glass material, not a complete station build or GPU test

probeMethod: Load the actual vendored Three module in Node (no WebGLRenderer constructed). Evaluate core/materials.js with only its import/export syntax replaced for VM binding to real THREE. Create existing house-glass and representative station-root, assign clip planes, call new shop options twice, then mirror current city owned-set and station-root traversal disposal. Observe dispose event count, cache membership, and clipping fields. This verifies the factory/disposal mechanism, not complete station initialization or GPU allocation.

minimalFix.recommendation: Create a dedicated city-owned clone of the existing city-local M.glass, set its cloned uTint/uOpacity/uStreaks uniforms to the requested values, register it in ownedMaterials, and pass it explicitly to buildTownApartment/buildLaundryShop. Preserve compile hooks/cache key as the existing city clone helper does, and ensure no station clip planes are attached. Use this separate instance only for shop panes.
avoid: Do not mutate M.glass itself: the cached city clone is used by other city windows.
Do not merely clone the new station factory return and leave the extra station cache entry as an assumed owner.
Do not dispose all station cache materials during city disposal or dispose a possibly shared cache hit.
minimalFix.benefit: Keeps the requested appearance, avoids creating a city-exclusive station cache entry, and gives the shop glass one explicit owner.
